detail.command: set -euo pipefail; rm -rf /tmp/WeatherFlowDeviceIcon; xcodebuild -project WeatherFlow.xcodeproj -scheme WeatherFlow -configuration Debug -destination 'id=00008130-0001252130E1401C' -derivedDataPath /tmp/WeatherFlowDeviceIcon DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=29G2Y6GWXQ CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic -allowProvisioningUpdates -allowProvisioningDeviceRegistration build | tee /tmp/weatherflow-icon-build.log; APP=/tmp/WeatherFlowDeviceIcon/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/WeatherFlow.app; test -d "$APP"; echo '=== APP ICON METADATA ==='; plutil -p "$APP/Info.plist" | grep -A12 -E 'CFBundleIcons|CFBundleIconName' || true; echo '=== ASSETS ==='; test -f "$APP/Assets.car" && ls -lh "$APP/Assets.car"; echo '=== SIGNATURE ==='; codesign -dv --verbose=2 "$APP" 2>&1 | grep -E 'Identifier=|TeamIdentifier=|Authority=' || true; echo '=== STATUS ==='; git status --short
